description: Use this when someone asks how many gallons or liters of water a swimming pool holds. Calculates the water in a swimming pool: the water surface in square meters, the average depth, liters and US gallons. Shapes: rectangle (length, width), round (diameter), oval with straight sides and half-circle ends (length, width), ellipse (length, width), and kidney (length, width across the larger round end, narrowWidth across the smaller one; area 0.45 × (A + B) × length, an approximation used in the pool trade). Give depth for a flat floor, or shallow and deep for a floor that slopes from one end to the other; the average depth is their mean.

deep.description: Water depth at the deep end of a pool whose floor slopes, in millimeters.

depth.description: Water depth of a pool with a flat floor, in millimeters.

diameter.description: Diameter of a round pool, in millimeters.

length.description: Overall length of a rectangle, oval, ellipse or kidney pool, in millimeters.

narrowWidth.description: Width of a kidney pool across its smaller round end, in millimeters.

shallow.description: Water depth at the shallow end of a pool whose floor slopes, in millimeters.

width.description: Width of a rectangle, oval or ellipse pool, or of a kidney pool across its larger round end, in millimeters.

name: calculate_pool_volume
title: Pool volume calculator
